Our Story

Engineering excellence
since 2003

A chemical engineer established Sunshine Chemicals in 2003, gifting it to his dedicated and business-minded life partner. The journey began with manufacturing and trading of industrial chemicals. Later, new product lines were added, establishing Sunshine Engineers — focused on iron & steel structure fabrication.

Today, headquartered in Ghaziabad in India's National Capital Region, we deliver world-class products to national and international markets with precision, speed, and integrity.

Uncompromising Quality

Every product scrutinised from manufacturing to shipping

Products &
Services

Two specialised units — one for advanced steel fabrication, one for industrial chemicals — delivering end-to-end industrial solutions.

Fabrication Unit

MS / SS Steel Fabrication & Structures

Using the latest technology and high-end machines to manufacture a wide range of MS/SS fabricated products for telecommunications, power transmission, solar energy, and civil infrastructure — from towers to bus shelters.
